name: Dura-Ace track rear hub
weight_description: Weight not yet sourced for the complete track hub without skewers. The 2017–2018 table lists 298 g including rear lockring under a weight heading excluding axle and lockring. These nut-fastened hubs do not use quick-release skewers, but the axle wording needs clarification before adopting the figure as a complete hub weight.
